decision_reason: None of the five preflight objects is both scientifically eligible for the 1,200–5,400-second long-video pilot core and authorized for full acquisition. The FLARE demos are exact declared-A/V compatibility examples but are too short; the Omni objects are access-blocked and unverified.

scientific_gate_definitions.audio_track_declared: Container metadata contains at least one soun handler; this does not require decoding media samples.
scientific_gate_definitions.content_audio_semantics_verified: Decoded audible content and its speech/ambient/semantic role have been inspected; this preflight did not perform that work.
scientific_gate_definitions.duration_eligible: Exact container duration is within the inclusive 1,200–5,400-second gate.
scientific_gate_definitions.access_authorized: The exact item may be accessed for the specified bounded or acquisition action under an explicit approved scope; reachability alone is insufficient.
scientific_gate_definitions.full_acquisition_authorized: A separate approval permits complete transfer and intended processing; no preflight result grants it.

recommended_next_route: Keep ccp-005 and ccp-006 as exact engineering/container compatibility fixtures, outside the pilot core.
Expand immutable exact-object discovery for candidates already within the 1,200–5,400-second gate; do not relax the 20-minute lower bound.
Resolve Omni gate/access only if expected scientific value justifies a new item-scoped authorization; if approved, repeat bounded inspection before considering acquisition.
Require separate positive decisions for decoded audio semantics, access, processing, full acquisition, and pilot inclusion.
